attacks.name: Swinging Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.

|!wild| |*Web Up|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§slow§Slow| special condition. Then, if the defender is |!size| 3 or less, this character may Push it Toward this character |!movement_small|.

attacks.name: Stun Web
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
After this attack is resolved, if it dealt |!damage|, the defender gains the |§stun§Stun| special condition.

attacks.name: Mastered Venom Blast
steps: Before |!damage| is dealt, the defender gains the |§shock§Shock| and |§stun§Stun| special conditions.

|!wild| |*Electric Arc|: After this attack is resolved, choose a number of other enemy characters within |!range| 3 of the defender equal to or less than the number of |!wild| results in the attack roll. The chosen characters suffer 2 |!damage|.

superPowers.name: Web Swing
superPowers.body: Place this character within |!range| 3 of its current position. The next time it makes a |*Swinging Strike| attack this Turn, add 2 dice to that attack roll. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: You Did You. Now Imma Do My Thing.
superPowers.body: After an attack targeting this character is resolved, this character may use this superpower. This character Advances Toward the attacker |!movement_small|. Then, if the attacker is within |!range| 2, this character may make a |*Swinging Strike| attack targeting it. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Ultimate Spider-Sense
superPowers.body: This character can reroll |!failure| results in its defense and dodge rolls. This character may reroll up to 2 of its defense or dodge dice.
